title: Derek Invests Entire Quantum Coffee Budget Into KRNL, Down 84.7%
body: Derek reportedly told friends, "The quantum technology will make this coffee budget investment superimposed with wealth." He now drinks regular coffee.
summary: Derek's quantum coffee fund is now 84.7% lighter after KRNL investment.

comments.content: Guys, this is clearly a Ponzi scheme. The whitepaper literally has "definitely not a scam" as a section header. Please do your research.
